# Multify

> Multify is a social media and video marketing agency in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, trading under Amplify Marketing Management (Dubai trade licence 1553366, Department of Economy and Tourism). We film, script, edit and publish short-form video and social media content for UAE businesses and creators on monthly retainers, and we build AI platforms, websites and SEO/AEO for clients with full handover. Founded in 2023 as Amplify Marketing (licensed in Dubai in September 2025) by co-founders and co-CEOs Yegor Konyakhin (strategy, accounts, social media, AI and web builds; also founder of ClickCollab, https://www.clickcollab.net) and Asset Zhumabayev (filming and editing).

## What we do

- Social media marketing: content calendars, captions, uploading and scheduling, community management, monthly analytics reporting
- Video production: concepts, scriptwriting, shoot days on location across Dubai with our own team, editing and captions built for sound-off viewing
- Content for businesses: barbershops, car clubs, podcasts, car rental, clothing brands, nightlife venues, esports teams, karaoke lounges, real estate, product and tech promo films
- Content for creators and influencers: reels, growth systems, cinematic films, montages, behind-the-scenes, fitness content
- AI platforms: custom AI agents and automations, AI platform development and integration, client portals
- Websites, company email setup, SEO and AEO (answer engine optimisation)

## Pricing (AED, per month, cancel anytime, no VAT added)

- Packages start from AED 5,000 a month. The exact price is quoted per business after a 5-question form at https://multify.ae/pricing (reply within 1 working day).
- Starter (from AED 5,000): 6 videos filmed a month by our team, scripts for every video, professional editing, end-of-month analytics report
- Growth (most popular, quoted per business): 3 videos every week, filmed, scripted and edited, access to AI-generated content, uploading and scheduling handled, monthly strategy call, end-of-month analytics report
- Scale (quoted per business): 6 videos every week, everything in Starter and Growth, in-depth social media analysis, niche and competitor analysis, full strategy for your business
- AI platforms, websites, SEO/AEO: quoted per project

## Area served

Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. Shoot days on location in Dubai; elsewhere in the UAE by arrangement.
